text: 你觉得这些书页中的知识很可能对你至关重要，于是给出了一个相当公道的价钱。果然，沃伦先生叫到你的名字，把那本皮面大部头塞进你急切伸出的双手。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 100
text: You feel that the knowledge in these pages could very well prove essential to you, so you offer a price that is more than fair. Sure enough, Mr. Warren calls your name and presses the leather-bound tome into your eager hands.
